_comment: Operational accounts the faucet keeps in gas.
The point of this file is that only the faucet needs a person. Every account
below has a 1 CELO floor; falling under it triggers a top-up back to
top_up_to_celo, paid out of the faucet. When the faucet itself gets low,
FUNDING_ALERT_EMAILS is emailed, because that is the one balance nothing
here can refill.
'priority' decides who gets paid first when the faucet cannot cover
everything at once. The paymaster sponsor is 1: every sponsored user
transaction depends on it, so its exhaustion stops the whole system rather
than one feature of it.
Top-ups are capped at one transaction per account per minute regardless of
balances, and an account topped up twice inside two minutes raises a drain
alert rather than being funded quietly.
'enabled' is the switch for moving funds and starts off, which is the way
to watch this before trusting it with transfers. Per-account 'auto_top_up'
false does the same for one account. FUNDING_AUTO_TOPUP in the environment
overrides this field either way, so the switch can be flipped on a running
deployment without editing this file; setting it false is the kill switch.
'alerts' is separate and defaults to ON even when it is absent: moving
money should take an opt-in, being told it is about to run out should not.
With top-ups off you still get emailed about a low faucet and about any
account below its floor that nothing is going to fix.

accounts.name: Paymaster sponsor
accounts.notes: First in line, always. Pays gas for every sponsored user transaction, so customer payments to merchants all stop together when it is empty - this is the account whose exhaustion stopped payments with no warning. It is the paymaster contract's sponsor() and belongs to Citizen Wallet, not us: we cannot sign for it, but it is an EOA and anyone may fund it. At roughly 0.03 CELO a transaction, the 1 CELO floor is about thirty transactions of warning and the 6 CELO target about two hundred.

accounts.name: Redeemer admin
accounts.notes: Grants REDEEMER_ROLE to approved merchant locations. Empty means a newly approved merchant silently cannot take payment.

accounts.name: Admin
accounts.notes: Watched, not funded: it signs rarely and is worth a person noticing. Set auto_top_up true once the rest has been running a while.
